caption: The drawing consists of outlines and patterns resembling parts of a garment, depicted in fine, black or gray lines on a beige or light tan background. The main object is a large, shield-like shape that takes up most of the upper and central part of the image, bordered with a delicate pattern of small circles and floral or star-shaped motifs. Inside the border, there are sporadically placed small, simple marks or symbols. Below the main shape, there are several smaller, similarly decorated shapes, each bordered with the same detailed ornamentation and containing sparse interior markings. The overall composition is neat and organized, with all shapes and patterns contained within a rectangular boundary centered on the page.
title: Waistcoat
